items.title: 21.6 Mukhtalif sitaron ke emission aur absorption spectra (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of emission and absorption spectra from stars (PDF 174-175).

blocks.text: Stars ki surface bohat garam aur ghani (dense) hoti hai aur taqreeban poori blackbody ki tarah kaam karti hai, is liye stars continuous spectrum (musalsal rangon ki patti) wali roshni kharij karte hain. Jab yeh roshni star ki bahar wali, nisbatan thandi atmosphere se guzarti hai to gas ki tahon ke atoms kuch khaas wavelengths jazb kar lete hain. Yeh woh wavelengths hain jo atoms mein electrons ke aik energy level se doosre mein jane (electronic transitions) ke barabar hain. Is se continuous spectrum mein un jagahon par kaali lakeerein ban jati hain jahan khaas rang jazb ho gaye. Isi ko absorption spectrum kehte hain. Jazb ki hui energy dobara unhi wavelengths par kharij hoti hai, lekin yeh photons har simt bikhar jate hain, is liye zameen par dekhne walon tak kam pohanchte hain. Is wajah se hamein aik khaas absorption spectrum milta hai jis mein kuch wavelengths ghaib hoti hain. Door ke stars aur galaxies ke emission aur absorption spectra mein yeh lakeerein apni maloom laboratory wavelengths se lambi wavelength par nazar aati hain (Fig. 21.5). Is ko redshift kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh is liye hota hai ke kainat mein safar karte hue photons (roshni) khinch jate hain.

blocks.alt: Red-Shift. Banafshi se surkh tak do spectra: Sooraj ki roshni ka spectrum aur door ki kehkashan ki roshni ka spectrum. Kehkashan ki chaar andheri lakeerein Sooraj wali se thori daen taraf hain, aur teer daen taraf. Neeche teer chhoti wavelength se lambi wavelength ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.5: Sooraj aur door ki kehkashaon ke roshni ke spectra, wavelength mein redshift (kitab ki Figure 21.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Har star ki roshni ki apni pehchan (signature) hoti hai. Us ke emission aur absorption spectra parh kar scientists maloom kar lete hain ke star kin elements se bana hai.

blocks.prompt: Stars ke spectra mein saaf rangon ki patti ke bajaye kaali lakeerein kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Star ki bahar wali thandi gas kuch khaas wavelengths jazb karti hai (jo us ke atoms ke electron transitions ke barabar hain). Un wavelengths par dobara kharij roshni har simt bikhar jati hai, is liye ham tak kam pohanchti hai aur woh wavelengths kaali lakeeron ki tarah nazar aati hain.

items: Stars: continuous spectrum, us par thandi atmosphere ki absorption lines (kaali lakeerein).
Lakeerein elements batati hain; door ki galaxies mein lambi wavelength ki taraf khiski hui (redshift).
